source: **Identical islands still share the same ids.** Two instances of the same island rendered with the same name, props and context share a single server render (and payload entry), so their HTML — including any {0}-generated ids — is identical, and the island context id used as prefix is the same. This results in duplicated {1} attributes in the DOM, which can break {2} references and {3} associations between the two instances. There is currently no workaround for this case.

Cela entraîne des attributs {1} dupliqués dans le DOM, ce qui peut casser les références {2} et les associations {3} entre les deux instances. Il n'existe actuellement aucun contournement pour ce cas.
